terms.gloss: spot on; literally “you touched it with a needle”
terms.comment: Where Labrax admits he is one letter more than a medicus: a mendīcus. The later school dialogues expand it to Rem acū tetigistī (Cordier, Schottenius).

sources: Lewis & Short: acus
Plautus (Rudens) and Cicero checked against the Perseus Latin texts; Plautus (Miles), Terence and the school dialogues from the Latinitas loci collections.
